# Paleon Training

> Paleon Training Limited (Warri, Nigeria) runs corporate AI and cybersecurity training for employees of companies in Nigeria, South Africa, Kenya and Ghana. Corporate training is online only, per learner or in a private company portal, as self-paced courses; it is not live, facilitator-led or hybrid. It also runs self-paced digital skills courses for graduates in Nigeria.

Contact for organisations: corporate@paleontraining.com, WhatsApp +44 7508 823495. Programme Director (designs and reviews all corporate courses): Ken Uwotu.

## Corporate training programmes

- [Corporate training homepage](https://paleontraining.com/): the three programmes, who designs the courses, and how a rollout works
- [Online staff training for companies](https://paleontraining.com/corporate-training/online-staff-training): how the private company portal works (buy seats, staff join with one link, HR tracks progress, certificates), prices per learner in all four countries
- AI Workflow Productivity & Process Transformation: generative AI for everyday work and redesigning repetitive workflows, with responsible-use rules. [Nigeria](https://paleontraining.com/ng/corporate-training/ai-workflow-productivity) · [South Africa](https://paleontraining.com/za/corporate-training/ai-workflow-productivity) · [Kenya](https://paleontraining.com/ke/corporate-training/ai-workflow-productivity) · [Ghana](https://paleontraining.com/gh/corporate-training/ai-workflow-productivity)
- CyberSecure Workforce: cybersecurity awareness training for every employee (phishing, payment fraud, data protection). [Nigeria](https://paleontraining.com/ng/corporate-training/cybersecure-workforce) · [South Africa](https://paleontraining.com/za/corporate-training/cybersecure-workforce) · [Kenya](https://paleontraining.com/ke/corporate-training/cybersecure-workforce) · [Ghana](https://paleontraining.com/gh/corporate-training/cybersecure-workforce)
- AI + Cybersecurity Professional Accelerator: combined AI and cybersecurity programme for managers and professionals. [Nigeria](https://paleontraining.com/ng/corporate-training/ai-cybersecurity-professional-accelerator) · [South Africa](https://paleontraining.com/za/corporate-training/ai-cybersecurity-professional-accelerator) · [Kenya](https://paleontraining.com/ke/corporate-training/ai-cybersecurity-professional-accelerator) · [Ghana](https://paleontraining.com/gh/corporate-training/ai-cybersecurity-professional-accelerator)
